# @macrosuite/client (vendored)

Precompiled snapshot of `@macrosuite/client` — the TypeScript client SDK for
the MacroRuntime local API — vendored here so this CLI installs standalone,
without the full [MacroSuite monorepo](https://github.com/endlessGold/macrosuite-engine).

This folder is generated (`dist/` + this file), not maintained directly. The
source of truth is `clients/ts/` in the monorepo; if you want to change SDK
behavior, change it there and re-vendor, not here.
